step1.title: Add Streams
step1.description: Watch multiple live streams from Twitch, Kick, YouTube, and custom channels simultaneously on a single screen, with real-time chat and total privacy.
step1.pilar1Desc: Watch Twitch, Kick, and YouTube streams side-by-side with zero clutter.
step1.pilar2Desc: Chat directly with full support for 7TV and BTTV emotes.
step1.pilar3Desc: Direct connections, offline transcription, and lossless recording.
step1.quickTip: Press {key} anytime to add a stream
step1.howToAdd: To add your first stream, press the {key} key or click '+' in the sidebar.

step2.title: Select Chat
step2.description: Pick which stream chat to display in the sidebar, or press keys {keys} to switch active chat instantly.

step3.title: Connect Accounts
step3.description: Connect your Twitch and Kick accounts to chat live, sync your followed channels, and use custom emotes from 7TV and BTTV.

step4.title: Browse by Category
step4.description: Filter streams by category to discover live broadcasts from Twitch and Kick with automatic caching.
step4.caption: Streams load in the background and stay cached as you switch categories.

step5.title: Live Transcription
step5.description: Generate real-time captions and optional English translation directly on your CPU using Whisper.
step5.note: No data is sent to external servers. Performance depends on your CPU model.

step6.title: Local Recording
step6.description: Record live streams directly from the source stream without quality loss into clean MP4 files.
step6.feature1: Direct stream capture in source quality
step6.note: Recordings are saved directly to your local drive.
